tools.name: Select All
tools.location: `RotoViewerToolbar`; `Viewer.hit_press` and `Viewer.hit_release` restrict point and marquee selection. Fresh Roto starts in Bezier draw mode; RotoPaint starts in Brush mode (NodeBased choice; Nuke default unspecified).

tools.name: Select Splines
tools.location: `RotoViewerToolbar`; `Viewer.hit_press` and `Viewer.hit_release` restrict point and marquee selection.

tools.name: Select Points
tools.location: `RotoViewerToolbar`; `Viewer.hit_press` and `Viewer.hit_release` restrict point and marquee selection.

tools.name: Select Feather Points
tools.location: `RotoViewerToolbar`; `Viewer.hit_press` and `Viewer.hit_release` restrict point and marquee selection.

tools.name: B-Spline
tools.difference: NodeBased supports polygon-spline drawing only; this exact shape tool is absent.

default_tool_decision.basis: NodeBased default while the reference documents no fixed per-group default.

controls.label: View
controls.location: No view list: a project here has one view (the control is shown by Nuke only for multi-view projects).
controls.difference: Not applicable: the Clone tool's View control picks the stereo or multi-view source and the guide shows it only when the project has multiple views; NodeBased has no multi-view projects.

shape_list.name: Name
shape_list.location: `rotolist.ShapeListTree` Name column (`roto-shape-row-name-*`, `rotopaint-row-name-*`, `*-layer-name-*`)

shape_list.name: Visible
shape_list.location: `rotolist.ShapeListTree` Visible column (`roto-shape-row-visible-*`, `rotopaint-row-visible-*`, `*-layer-visible-*`)

shape_list.name: Lock
shape_list.location: `rotolist.ShapeListTree` Lock column (`roto-shape-row-locked-*`, `rotopaint-row-locked-*`, `*-layer-locked-*`)

shape_list.name: Overlay color
shape_list.location: `rotolist.ShapeListTree` Overlay color column (`*-row-overlay-*`); stored as `overlay_color`, drawn by the Viewer outline, never rendered

shape_list.name: Color
shape_list.location: `rotolist.ShapeListTree` Color column (`*-row-color-*`); `paint.rasterise` draws a RotoPaint shape in its own colour (its alpha scales the coverage)

shape_list.name: Invert
shape_list.location: `rotolist.ShapeListTree` Invert column (`*-row-invert-*`); shapes invert their matte in `roto.rasterise`, strokes invert their footprint in `paint.apply_stroke`

shape_list.name: Blending
shape_list.location: `rotolist.ShapeListTree` Blending column (`*-row-blend-*`); `shapes.BLEND_MODES` (Roto) and `shapes.PAINT_BLEND_MODES` (RotoPaint); `roto.blend_onto`

shape_list.name: Motion blur
shape_list.location: `rotolist.ShapeListTree` Motion blur column (`*-row-motion_blur-*`)

shape_list.name: View
shape_list.location: No View column: a project here has one view (the column is shown by Nuke only for multi-view projects).
shape_list.difference: Not applicable: the View column lists the views an item appears in and the guide shows it only for multi-view projects; NodeBased has no multi-view projects.

shape_list.name: Lifetime
shape_list.location: `rotolist.ShapeListTree` Lifetime column (`*-row-lifetime-*`): shows the type and range, opens the panel's lifetime editor

shape_list.name: Source
shape_list.location: `rotolist.ShapeListTree` Source column (`*-row-source-*`)

shape_list.name: Layers and folders
shape_list.location: `rotolist.ShapeListTree` tree, front-most item first at every level as in Nuke (`rotolist.reverse_tree`; the stored order stays render order): layers as folders, drag in/out and reorder, a layer's Visible and Lock apply to its children; `shapes.layer_states`; `shapes.resolve_layer_transform`; the layer Transform controls in `rotopanel._layer_transform_controls`; the transform box with the layer row selected

shape_list.name: Add new layer
shape_list.location: `rotolist.ShapeListTree`.cmd_add_layer, context menu `roto-list-add-layer`

shape_list.name: Duplicate
shape_list.location: `rotolist.ShapeListTree`.cmd_duplicate, context menu `roto-list-duplicate` (items and layers with their contents)

shape_list.name: Copy > Curve
shape_list.location: `rotolist.ShapeListTree`.cmd_copy, context menu Copy > Curve
shape_list.difference: Strokes have no curve and are skipped.

shape_list.name: Cut > Curve
shape_list.location: `rotolist.ShapeListTree`.cmd_cut, context menu Cut > Curve
shape_list.difference: Strokes have no curve and are skipped.

shape_list.name: Paste > Spline
shape_list.location: `rotolist.ShapeListTree`.cmd_paste, context menu Paste > Spline (pastes across Roto and RotoPaint)

shape_list.name: Delete
shape_list.location: `rotolist.ShapeListTree`.cmd_delete, context menu `roto-list-delete` (a layer takes its contents with it)

shape_list.name: Set lifetime / frame range
shape_list.location: `rotolist.ShapeListTree`.cmd_set_lifetime, context menu dialog `roto-list-set-lifetime`

shape_list.name: Planar-track
shape_list.location: `rotolist.ShapeListTree`.cmd_planar_track, context menu `roto-list-planar-track` (the panel's existing track action)

viewer_editing.name: Add point
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.mousePressEvent` → `Viewer._insert_roto_point`.

viewer_editing.name: Delete point
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.keyPressEvent` → `Viewer._delete_roto_points`.

viewer_editing.name: Move point
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.mousePressEvent`, `Viewer.mouseMoveEvent`, `Viewer._commit_roto_drag`.

viewer_editing.name: Select several points
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.hit_press`; Ctrl/Cmd+LMB adds points to the selection; marquee selection is also supported.

viewer_editing.name: Select all points
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.keyPressEvent` Ctrl+A branch.

viewer_editing.name: Feather add
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.keyPressEvent` E applies per-point feather offsets; Shift+E removes feather.

viewer_editing.name: Feather drag
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.mousePressEvent` feather-handle branch; `Viewer._commit_roto_drag`.

viewer_editing.name: Feather reset
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.keyPressEvent` Shift+E

viewer_editing.name: Tangent create
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.mouseReleaseEvent` point-draw drag; `Viewer.finish_roto_draw`.

viewer_editing.name: Tangent move both
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.mouseMoveEvent` Shift-drag snaps the opposite tangent to the same length.

viewer_editing.name: Break tangent
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.mousePressEvent` tangent branch records Ctrl; `Viewer._commit_roto_drag`.

viewer_editing.name: Cusp point
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.keyPressEvent` Shift+Z → `Viewer._set_roto_tangent_mode(True)`.

viewer_editing.name: Smooth point
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.keyPressEvent` Z → `Viewer._set_roto_tangent_mode(False)`.

viewer_editing.name: Transform box
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.keyPressEvent` T toggles `_roto_box_geometry` while a Roto selection is active.

viewer_editing.name: Transform-box center/pivot
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer._roto_box_action`, `_roto_pivot_updates` and `_commit_roto_drag`; dragging the centre preserves every rendered control point. `tests.test_roto_toolbar_r1` checks the pivot move and single undo.

viewer_editing.name: Transform-box pivot modify
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.mousePressEvent` maps Ctrl/Cmd+Shift drag on the transform handle to pivot modification.

viewer_editing.name: Nudge point
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.keyPressEvent` numeric keypad arrows move selected Roto points by one pixel.

viewer_editing.name: Draw Bezier/B-Spline freely
viewer_editing.location: Viewer.hit_press; Viewer.hit_move; Viewer.hit_release; Viewer.finish_roto_draw
viewer_editing.difference: Ctrl/Cmd+drag commits a closed freehand spline.

viewer_editing.name: Bezier/B-Spline handles/tension
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.hit_press` Ctrl/Cmd+Alt-drag on a B-Spline point sets that point's animatable `tension`; `roto.tensioned_controls` and `roto.flatten_points` evaluate it; uniform cubic B-Spline when tension is 0.
viewer_editing.difference: The guide names the gesture but gives no scale or formula: 100 screen pixels of horizontal drag is a tension of 1, and a point's effective control is P + 0.5 t (P - M), M the midpoint of its neighbours (convention, in docs/ROTO_NUKE_UI.md).

viewer_editing.name: Sharp exit while drawing
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.hit_release` Shift+LMB commits a sharp open-spline end.

viewer_editing.name: B-Spline tension
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.hit_press` Ctrl/Cmd+Alt-drag on a B-Spline point sets that point's animatable `tension`; `roto.tensioned_controls` and `roto.flatten_points` evaluate it; uniform cubic B-Spline when tension is 0.
viewer_editing.difference: The guide names the gesture but gives no scale or formula: 100 screen pixels of horizontal drag is a tension of 1, and a point's effective control is P + 0.5 t (P - M), M the midpoint of its neighbours (convention, in docs/ROTO_NUKE_UI.md).

viewer_editing.name: Close shape
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.keyPressEvent` Enter; `Viewer.mouseReleaseEvent` closes on first point

viewer_editing.name: Leave shape open
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.keyPressEvent` Escape while Open Spline is active commits an open shape.

viewer_editing.name: Tool change
viewer_editing.location: `RotoViewerToolbar.choose` finalizes an open spline and switches to the chosen tool.

viewer_editing.name: Escape to selection
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.keyPressEvent` Escape commits Open Spline and returns to Select Points.

viewer_editing.name: Brush size
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.hit_press`, `Viewer.hit_move`, and `Viewer.hit_release`; Shift+drag adjusts the viewer brush and mirrors the Brush size field.

viewer_editing.name: Clone offset
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.hit_press`, `Viewer.hit_move`, `Viewer.hit_release`; Ctrl/Cmd+LMB drag sets the clone source offset and Ctrl/Cmd+Shift resets it.

viewer_editing.name: Reveal onion skin
viewer_editing.location: RotoViewerToolbar.settings_strip; Viewer._paint_reveal_onion
viewer_editing.difference: The selected Reveal source appears as an opacity-controlled overlay.

viewer_editing.name: Selection tool cycle
viewer_editing.location: `RotoViewerToolbar`; `Viewer.keyPressEvent`

viewer_editing.name: Tool mode cycle
viewer_editing.location: `Viewer.keyPressEvent`: S (no modifiers, pointer over the Viewer) steps through the tools of the active group, as the guide's 'modes of the currently selected tool'.

viewer_editing.name: Paint tool cycles
viewer_editing.location: `RotoViewerToolbar`; `Viewer.keyPressEvent`

timing_animation.name: Set key: spline
timing_animation.location: `RotoPanel.build_panel` and `build_paint_timing_controls`; selected spline current/total count, navigation, set and delete controls for Roto and RotoPaint.

timing_animation.name: Delete key: spline
timing_animation.location: `RotoPanel.build_panel` and `build_paint_timing_controls`; selected spline keys can be deleted at the current frame for Roto and RotoPaint.

timing_animation.name: Set/delete point keys
timing_animation.location: `RotoPanel.build_panel` and `build_paint_timing_controls`; set/delete actions affect the selected points for Roto and RotoPaint.

timing_animation.name: Set key: transform
timing_animation.location: `RotoPanel.build_panel` and `Window.build_node_panel`; per-field keys for Roto and RotoPaint transforms.

timing_animation.name: Lifetime types
timing_animation.location: Roto and RotoPaint property panels expose All, Start to, Single, To end and Range for shapes and strokes.

timing_animation.name: Lifetime endpoints
timing_animation.location: Roto and RotoPaint panels show From/To fields only for the selected lifetime mode and preserve existing endpoint payloads.

timing_animation.name: Ripple editing
timing_animation.location: Select tools' settings strip: Ripple edit toggle, Ripple mode (all, from start, to end, range) with Ripple from/to, a red border on the Viewer while on; `rotoripple.ripple_shapes` applied in `Viewer._commit_roto_shapes` for drags and keypad nudges, one undo step.

timing_animation.name: Per-shape keyframe controls
timing_animation.location: Roto and RotoPaint panels expose All, Spline, Transform and Attributes key scopes for the selected shape item.

timing_animation.name: Motion blur keys
timing_animation.location: `rotopanel` samples, shutter and offset key buttons; the list's Motion blur cell shows the shutter's key state and, with autokey on, sets a shutter key at the current frame (`rotolist.ShapeListTree.edit_motion_blur`).
timing_animation.difference: A key of 0 on the shutter is blur off from that frame; the cell is checked while the flag is on and the shutter is above 0.
